Honestly, is the pricier one worth the extra, or is the cheaper one fine?

Totally hear you! If you just want the best deal per cup and already have a way to mix your mud, the 90-serving bag is absolutely fine—no need to splurge.

But if you’re new to MUD\WTR or want the frother and extras, the starter kit is worth the little extra for the full experience. Both options are solid, so you can’t go wrong! It really comes down to whether those extras matter to you or not. 😊
